title: These ‘Ghostly’ Galaxies Have Lost Their Dark Matter
summary: The galaxies’ dark matter was ejected during a collision, but ironically, its absence is some of the best evidence of the elusive substance yet.
llm_summary: Astronomers have identified a handful of “ghostly” galaxies that appear to have been stripped of almost all their dark matter after a violent collision with a larger neighbor. The impact flung the invisible mass out of the smaller galaxies, leaving them dominated by ordinary stars and gas—a rare situation that actually provides a clear, observable test of dark‑matter physics.
